_comment: Notice boards with a white diamond. x/z = position, rot = rotation (radians), html = panel content. Optional 'action' = event name emitted on E instead of opening a panel (ARCHITECTURE.md > Events). Feature-owned boards (e.g. BOWLING) are placed by their feature in js/features/.

Dunia kecil yang bisa dijelajahi dengan mobil — terinspirasi dari bruno-simon.com.
